<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Abdullah Khan | Portfolio</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#0e1712;--alt:#13211a;--card:#1a2c22;--text:#eef3ee;--mute:#b3c2b6;--acc:#8fd36b;--on:#0e1712;--line:#2b4234;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:light){:root:not([data-theme="dark"]){--bg:#f4f7f1;--alt:#e8efe4;--card:#fff;--text:#14241a;--mute:#4a5f50;--acc:#2f7a3a;--on:#fff;--line:#c9d8c6}}
:root[data-theme="light"]{--bg:#f4f7f1;--alt:#e8efe4;--card:#fff;--text:#14241a;--mute:#4a5f50;--acc:#2f7a3a;--on:#fff;--line:#c9d8c6}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:calc(70px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px))}
body{margin:0;font-family:Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.6}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--acc);outline-offset:3px}
header{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:20;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) 5% 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;height:calc(64px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px))}
.logo{font-weight:700;font-size:1.3rem}.logo span{color:var(--acc)}
nav{display:flex;gap:2rem}nav a{font-weight:500;font-size:.95rem;padding:.3rem 0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent}
nav a:hover,nav a.on{color:var(--acc);border-color:var(--acc)}
#menu{display:none;background:none;border:0;color:var(--text);font-size:1.7rem;cursor:pointer}
section{padding:6.5rem 5% 4rem;min-height:70vh}
.alt{background:var(--alt)}
.wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:auto}
#home{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:100vh}
.hero{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:3rem;width:100%}
.hero h3{font-size:1.5rem;margin:0}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,6vw,3.8rem);margin:.1rem 0;line-height:1.15}
.hero h2{font-size:1.6rem;margin:0}.role{color:var(--acc)}.role::after{content:"|";margin-left:2px;animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}
.hero p,.about p{color:var(--mute);max-width:46ch}
.social{display:flex;gap:.9rem;margin:1.5rem 0}
.social a{width:42px;height:42px;border:2px solid var(--acc);border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--acc);transition:.25s}
.social a:hover{background:var(--acc);color:var(--on)}
.social svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:currentColor}
.btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--acc);color:var(--on);font-weight:600;border:0;border-radius:40px;padding:.8rem 2.2rem;font:600 .95rem Poppins,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 0 18px color-mix(in srgb,var(--acc) 45%,transparent);transition:.25s}
.btn:hover{box-shadow:0 0 30px var(--acc)}
.hex{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 22px color-mix(in srgb,var(--acc) 60%,transparent));flex:none}
.hex div{width:min(360px,70vw);aspect-ratio:1;background:var(--acc);padding:6px;clip-path:polygon(50% 0,93% 25%,93% 75%,50% 100%,7% 75%,7% 25%)}
.hex img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 12%;display:block;clip-path:polygon(50% 0,93% 25%,93% 75%,50% 100%,7% 75%,7% 25%)}
.about{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4rem}
.about .hex div{width:min(320px,70vw)}
.about h2,.center h2{font-size:2.3rem;margin:0 0 .3rem}.about h4{color:var(--acc);font-size:1.3rem;margin:.2rem 0 1rem}
.center{text-align:center}.center>p{color:var(--mute);margin:0 auto 2.5rem;max-width:52ch}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:1.5rem}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:2rem 1.5rem;transition:.25s}
.card:hover{border-color:var(--acc);box-shadow:0 0 22px color-mix(in srgb,var(--acc) 35%,transparent)}
.card svg{width:44px;height:44px;stroke:var(--acc);fill:none;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.card h3{margin:.8rem 0 .4rem}.card p{color:var(--mute);margin:0;font-size:.95rem}
form{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1rem;text-align:left}
input,textarea{width:100%;font:inherit;color:var(--text);background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:.85rem 1rem}
input::placeholder,textarea::placeholder{color:var(--mute)}
textarea{grid-column:1/-1;min-height:150px;resize:vertical}form .btn{grid-column:1/-1;justify-self:center}
footer{background:var(--alt);border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:1.4rem 5%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--mute)}
footer a{background:var(--acc);color:var(--on);width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:700}
@media(max-width:800px){
#menu{display:block}
nav{position:fixed;top:calc(64px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));left:0;right:0;flex-direction:column;gap:0;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:none}
nav.open{display:flex}nav a{padding:1rem 5%;border:0}
.hero,.about{flex-direction:column-reverse;text-align:center;gap:2rem}.about{flex-direction:column}
.hero p,.about p{margin-inline:auto}.social{justify-content:center}
form{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
</style></head><body>
<header><a class="logo" href="#home">Abdullah<span>.</span></a>
<button id="menu" aria-label="Open menu" aria-expanded="false">&#9776;</button>
<nav id="nav"><a href="#home" class="on">Home</a><a href="#about">About</a><a href="#skills">Skills</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a></nav></header>

<section id="home"><div class="wrap hero"><div>
<h3>Hello, I’m</h3><h1>Abdullah Khan</h1><h2>And I’m a <span class="role" id="role"></span></h2>
<p>I turn everyday phone shots into striking photos, and I study Computer Science at Riphah.</p>

<a href="mailto:abdullahkhanft5@gmail.com" aria-label="Email"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 5h18a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v12a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H3a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1zm1.5 2v.4l7.500 5.100 7.500-5.100V7h-15zm15 2.800l-7.500 5.100-7.500-5.100V17h15V9.800z"/></svg></a></div>
<a class="btn" href="#contact">Contact Me</a></div>
